desc:
🚨 The test begins! But... something feels suspicious about this classroom?
Become a supervisor and find AI cheating devices hidden in ordinary objects!

🔍 From AI glasses and erasers to uniform buttons, wireless earphones, water bottles, pencil cases, markers, exam ticket badges, watches, and hair clips—even ordinary items can be AI devices! Don't miss the small lenses and blinking red lights, nor the student's suspicious behavior.

💥 If you find them, arrest them! Smash AI devices easily with test paper words and various tool skins.

🤝 You can play alone or with up to 4 friends! Divide the area and search together.

📚 5 minutes per class! Find 20 new devices hidden in each class period.

⬆️ Use the gold collected from discoveries to enhance your detection abilities and movement speed.

🏆 Find all 100 items and challenge yourself to achieve a perfect clear and set a new fastest time!

Don't let appearances fool you. A fair test depends on your keen observation skills!

🏷️ Tags: Become
